name: Rinkai Gasshuku
source:
The protagonist, Sanada Naoto, transfers to a new school at the worst possible time, right before summer vacation.
His classmates are all eccentrics, and they suddenly become attached to him on first meeting, accuse him of things he didn't do, and he even reunites with his childhood friend...

And so, he has to go to an overnight seaside training camp with this group.

Masato doesn't want to go, but his cousin encourages him to.

"But you know, this training camp might actually be interesting."
"If you spend days with new people on a trip, you'll see things you never thought you'd see..."

And so an unforgettable summer began.
translation:
主人公真田直人偏偏在暑假前这个最糟糕的时机转入新学校。
同班同学全是怪人，初次见面便突然与他纠缠不休，指责他做了根本没做过的事，他甚至还与青梅竹马重逢……

于是，他不得不与这群人一同参加过夜的海滨集训。

真人不想去，表亲却鼓励了他。

“不过，你知道吗，这次集训说不定真的会很有趣。”
“如果在旅行中与新认识的人共度几天，你会看见过去从未想过能看到的事物……”

就这样，一段难忘的夏日开始了。
